description: This file defines the 'Login' feature for the Users in the project, including data models, request validation, and the handler for processing user login requests, interacting with database context, password hashing, and JWT token generation.

classes.name: Login.UserData
classes.description: Data model representing user credentials (email and password) for login.

classes.name: Login.Command
classes.description: Request command encapsulating user data for login procedure, implementing IRequest to expect a UserEnvelope response.

classes.name: Login.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validation class ensuring the login command contains non-null, non-empty email and password.

classes.name: Login.Handler
classes.description: Handles the login request, verifies credentials, generates JWT token, and returns user information encapsulated in UserEnvelope.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Executes the login process: fetches user by email, verifies password, generates JWT token, and maps domain person to User.
